en.main:
Weapon Kills grant #e${10 * #d}% Melee Ability Energy.

Kills with Sniper Rifles, Shotguns, Glaives, and Fusion Rifles grant #e${20 * #d}%.

Dealing Melee Damage grants 35 Handling for 3 seconds.

Ability energy gained may be significantly decreased based on your selected ability's Chunk Energy Scalar. Learn more about this mechanic in <link our explainer blog post on the Clarity website [https://url.d2clarity.com/chunk-energy-scalars] />.

enhanced (
var d = 1.1
#e Melee Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%. (e.g. 10%<arrow/>11%)
)

en.main:
While at/above #e${50-#d}% of the Base Magazine Capacity:
Direct Hits apply 60 <stasis/>Slow Stacks for <pve 4 /> <pvp [1.5] /> seconds (<pve 8 /> <pvp [2] /> with <stasis/>Whisper of Durance) to enemies within 4 meters of the target.

Micro-Missile Sidearms and Rapid-Fire Fusion Rifles only apply 40 <stasis/>Slow Stacks.

Only activates once per shot/burst.

enhanced (
var d = 10
#e Magazine capacity thershold is lowered by 10% (50%<arrow/>40%).
)
